description: This file defines an abstract base class for implementing MQTT protocol adapters using Vert.x in the Eclipse Hono project. It manages MQTT server configuration, connection handling, authentication, message forwarding (telemetry, events, commands), subscription management, tracing, and metrics integration. The class provides a framework for building MQTT adapters that handle device connections, message publishing, and command delivery within a multi-tenant environment.

classes.name: AbstractVertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating Vert.x based MQTT protocol adapters in Eclipse Hono, managing server lifecycle, connection handling, authentication, message forwarding, subscription, and metrics.
